chain.title: The Basic Pitch
chain.desc: A log over a log and a stick, two at a time. The plain Roof is the 45-degree pitch every other roof piece is a variation of, and it exists in twenty-eight materials.

chain.title: Cap the Ridge
chain.desc: Two logs with a stick between them, two at a time. The Top Roof is the ridge piece that closes the peak where two pitches meet.

chain.title: A Window in the Slope
chain.desc: A log and glass in an L, two at a time. The attic roof is the only piece that carries glazing, which makes it the dormer of the set.

chain.title: A Sharper Angle
chain.desc: Three logs stacked with a stick, four at a time. Steep roofs climb two blocks for every one across, and Upper Steep is the matching top half.

chain.title: A Shallower Angle
chain.desc: Two logs and a stick laid flat, four at a time. Lower roofs climb one for every two, and Upper Lower is their top half - which is why every material ships seven roof pieces, not one.

chain.title: Toggle the Piece
chain.desc: An iron ingot, nuggets and a stick. The mod's own hint says it plainly: 'Right click on the top roof to toggle between states'. It is the only tool in the mod and the only non-block item.

chain.title: The Same Roof in Planks
chain.desc: Planks and a stick instead of logs. Every wood ships both a log-textured and a planks-textured roof set, which is why the wood half of this mod is 28 log materials and 11 planks materials.

chain.title: Roofs by Stonecutter
chain.desc: One stonecut of black terracotta. The sixteen terracotta and sixteen concrete colours each give all seven roof shapes straight off the stonecutter, with no crafting grid involved.

chain.title: Stone Roofs, Cut Not Crafted
chain.desc: Also a stonecut. Bricks, nether bricks, blackstone, deepslate, andesite, diorite, granite, sandstone, prismarine, mud brick, stone and cobblestone all cut into roof pieces the same way.

chain.title: Straw Overhead
chain.desc: A hay block and a stick, two at a time. Thatch is the one roof material that is neither wood, stone nor a dyed block.

chain.title: Mosaic
chain.desc: Bamboo mosaic and a stick. The mosaic set is separate from the plain bamboo one and is the only roof made from a vanilla decorative variant.

chain.title: The Blank
chain.desc: One stonecut of plain terracotta. The Base set is the undyed neutral, and it is the only roof family that also ships a Roof Block and a Roof Slab.

chain.title: Solid, Not Sloped
chain.desc: Cut from black terracotta. Roof blocks and roof slabs exist only in base, white, light gray, gray and black - five greys and nothing else, which is a deliberately small set.

chain.title: Iron Nuggets in a U
chain.desc: Three iron nuggets. The Base Rain Gutter is not a placeable gutter itself - it is the ingredient for both of the pieces that are.

chain.title: The Run
chain.desc: Three base rain gutters in a row. This is the horizontal length that runs along the eaves.

chain.title: The Downspout
chain.desc: Three base rain gutters in a column. Both gutter pieces then dye eight at a time into all sixteen colours.

chain.title: Cloth Over the Window
chain.desc: A coloured carpet between two white carpets. Awnings come in fifteen colours - there is no white one, because white is the stripe.
